cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS stores FROM analytics.dim_store AS s JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND s.is_open
assumptions: “Has” means stores currently open.
cases.answer: The company currently has 5 open stores in Surabaya.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS active_products FROM analytics.dim_product AS p JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS department ON department.category_id = c.parent_category_id WHERE p.is_active = TRUE AND department.category_name_id = 'Elektronik'
cases.answer: Ada 38 produk aktif di kategori Elektronik. Perhitungan mencakup semua subkategori Elektronik.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.payment_method AS payment_method FROM analytics.fact_payments AS p WHERE p.payment_status <> 'voided' ORDER BY p.payment_method
assumptions: Voided payments for cancelled orders do not count as a payment method customers used.
cases.answer: Customers have used bank_transfer, card, cash, cod, ewallet, and qris; voided payments for cancelled orders are excluded.

cases.sql: SELECT s.opened_date FROM analytics.dim_store AS s WHERE s.store_name = 'Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong'
assumptions: “Gading Serpong store” refers to Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong.
cases.answer: Assuming you mean Arunika Tangerang Gading Serpong, the store opened on 2025-02-14.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
cases.answer: There have been 2,079 cancelled orders in total.

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(sh.shipping_fee_idr) AS shipping_fee_idr FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS sh WHERE CAST((sh.shipped_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
cases.answer: Total ongkos kirim untuk paket yang dikirim selama tahun 2025 adalah Rp 163 juta.

cases.sql: SELECT ticket_category, ROUND(CAST(AVG(csat_score) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS avg_csat_score FROM analytics.fact_support_tickets AS t WHERE ticket_status = 'resolved' GROUP BY ticket_category ORDER BY ticket_category
assumptions: Average includes resolved tickets with a recorded CSAT score; unrated tickets are ignored by AVG.
cases.answer: Average CSAT scores for resolved tickets, by category: account — 4.01; delivery — 3.44; other — 4.03; payment — 4.07; product_quality — 4; and refund — 3.47. The averages include resolved tickets with a recorded CSAT score; unrated tickets are excluded.

cases.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS registered_customers FROM analytics.dim_customer AS c GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment
cases.answer: Registered customers by segment are: member, 5,034; regular, 14,014; and vip, 952.

cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity), 0) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r WHERE r.reason = 'damaged'
assumptions: “Arrived damaged” corresponds to the return reason 'damaged'. Count all matching returned units, with no date restriction.
cases.answer: A total of 1,950 units were returned for the reason “damaged,” including all matching returns with no date restriction.

cases.sql: SELECT p.brand AS brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5
cases.answer: In 2025, excluding cancelled orders, the brands with the most units sold were Rasa Nusa (7,073 units), Melati (5,349), Sekar (5,114), Rupa (5,039), and Sari Buah (4,543).

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(t.visitors) AS visitors FROM analytics.fact_store_daily_traffic AS t JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.traffic_date >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND t.traffic_date < CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_name ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 1
cases.answer: Dengan asumsi yang digunakan, Arunika Jakarta Senayan memiliki jumlah pengunjung terbanyak selama seluruh bulan kalender Agustus 2026, yaitu 1.482 pengunjung.

cases.sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(*) AS late_purchase_orders FROM analytics.fact_purchase_orders AS po JOIN analytics.dim_supplier AS s ON s.supplier_id = po.supplier_id WHERE po.received_date > po.expected_date GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY late_purchase_orders DESC LIMIT 1
cases.answer: PD Halim (08) had the most late purchase orders, with 182 arriving after the expected date.

cases.sql: SELECT s.courier, COUNT(*) AS parcels_delivered FROM analytics.fact_shipments AS s WHERE s.shipment_status = 'delivered' AND CAST((s.delivered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.courier ORDER BY s.courier
assumptions: Count parcels by the WIB date they were delivered during September 2026.
cases.answer: In September 2026, parcels delivered by courier (using the WIB delivery date) were: AnterAja — 124, GoSend — 113, JNE — 338, J&T Express — 314, and SiCepat — 221.

cases.sql: SELECT s.traffic_source, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code IN ('website', 'app') AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.traffic_source
cases.answer: For website and app sessions in 2025, conversion rates by traffic source were: affiliate, 7.8%; direct, 8.4%; email, 8.3%; organic_search, 8.7%; paid_search, 8.4%; push_notification, 8.4%; and social, 8.2%. Session dates are interpreted in Jakarta time.

cases.sql: SELECT top_cat.category_name AS category_name, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS sub_cat ON sub_cat.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS top_cat ON top_cat.category_id = sub_cat.parent_category_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((r.returned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((r.returned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY top_cat.category_name ORDER BY returned_units DESC LIMIT 1
assumptions: “Selama 2025” berarti retur yang diproses pada tanggal WIB tahun 2025; kategori utama ditentukan dari kategori level 1 induk produk.
cases.answer: Kategori utama dengan unit retur terbanyak adalah Fashion, sebanyak 609 unit. Periode dihitung berdasarkan tanggal retur WIB, dan kategori utama ditentukan dari kategori level satu induk produk.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key = CAST('2025-11-11' AS DATE) AND d.is_harbolnas
assumptions: Count all orders placed that day, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: There were 183 orders placed on Harbolnas, including cancelled orders.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
assumptions: “Last month” means the full calendar month before the as-of date: September 2026. Refunds are attributed to the order date.
cases.answer: Net revenue last month was IDR 6.65B; refunds are attributed to the order date.

cases.sql: WITH daily_orders AS (SELECT d.date_key, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM analytics.dim_date AS d LEFT JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) = d.date_key WHERE d.is_ramadan AND d.year = 2025 GROUP BY d.date_key) SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(orders AS DECIMAL)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS orders_per_day FROM daily_orders
assumptions: Menghitung semua pesanan yang tercatat, termasuk yang dibatalkan.
Rata-rata mencakup setiap hari Ramadan 2025 yang ditandai di kalender, termasuk hari tanpa pesanan.
cases.answer: Rata-rata jumlah pesanan per hari selama bulan Ramadan 2025 adalah 82,1. Perhitungan mencakup semua pesanan yang tercatat, termasuk yang dibatalkan, serta setiap hari Ramadan yang ditandai di kalender, termasuk hari tanpa pesanan.

cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN d.is_weekend THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE d.date_key BETWEEN CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY d.is_weekend ORDER BY d.is_weekend
assumptions: Counts all orders placed, including cancelled orders.
cases.answer: In calendar Q2 2026, 4,009 orders were placed on weekdays and 1,996 on weekends. The count includes cancelled orders.

cases.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')) AS DATE) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY completed_orders DESC, month_start ASC LIMIT 1
assumptions: Busiest month means the month with the highest count of completed orders, using WIB business dates.
If months tie, return the earliest month.
cases.answer: The busiest month was 2025-03-01, with 2,367 completed orders. This uses WIB business dates and selects the earliest month if counts tie.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE)), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(rf.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = n.order_date LEFT JOIN refunds AS rf ON rf.order_id = n.order_id WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
cases.answer: Dengan mengecualikan pesanan yang dibatalkan dan mengurangi pengembalian dana, pendapatan bersih pada kuartal fiskal pertama FY2026 adalah Rp 19,9 miliar.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(o.total_amount) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*)) AS aov_idr FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: Interpreted 2025 as the calendar year, using WIB business dates.
Applied the canonical AOV definition: orders not cancelled, using total_amount before refunds.
cases.answer: The average order value in 2025 was IDR 3.56M, using non-cancelled orders and total amount before refunds, based on WIB business dates.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0)) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0), 4) AS return_rate FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN analytics.dim_category AS top ON top.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.order_item_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_qty FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_item_id) AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND top.category_name = 'Fashion' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
assumptions: Return rate dihitung sebagai unit yang dikembalikan dibagi unit terjual pada pesanan non-cancelled, dengan tahun pesanan berdasarkan tanggal WIB.
cases.answer: Return rate kategori Fashion untuk pesanan sepanjang 2025 adalah 4,9%, dihitung sebagai unit yang dikembalikan dibagi unit terjual pada pesanan yang tidak dibatalkan, dengan tahun pesanan berdasarkan tanggal WIB.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS active_customers FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) > CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) - 90 AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: “End of the data” means 2026-09-30; active customers are counted over the 90 days up to and including that date.
cases.answer: There were 3,021 active customers as of the end of the data, counting customers with a completed order during the ninety-day period through that date.

cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(s.converted AS INT)) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_web_sessions AS s JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_code = 'website' AND CAST((s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Conversion rate is converted website sessions divided by all website sessions, using the WIB session start date.
cases.answer: The website session conversion rate in September 2026 was 8.3%, calculated as converted sessions divided by all website sessions using the WIB session start date.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr) AS gross_sales, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2025 GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.gross_sales) AS gross_sales_idr, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id
cases.answer: Gross sales were IDR 79.5B, and net revenue was IDR 74B. These figures use the stated fiscal-year window and WIB order dates.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.channel_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT c.channel_name AS sales_channel, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_id = n.channel_id GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY c.channel_name
assumptions: Omzet berarti net revenue: nilai setelah diskon dikurangi refund, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan.
cases.answer: Omzet (net revenue) tahun 2025 per channel: Marketplace sebesar Rp 8,81 miliar, Mobile app sebesar Rp 13,7 miliar, Physical store sebesar Rp 40,6 miliar, dan Website sebesar Rp 9,71 miliar. Omzet dihitung setelah diskon dikurangi refund, tidak termasuk pesanan yang dibatalkan, dengan tanggal bisnis WIB.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT n.customer_id, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue_idr DESC LIMIT 10
assumptions: “Best customers” means the 10 registered customers with the highest lifetime net revenue; cancelled orders are excluded and refunds are subtracted.
cases.answer: The highest-ranking customers are customer 330 at IDR 2.53B, customer 12244 at IDR 1.65B, and customer 198 at IDR 1.58B in lifetime net revenue; the table shows the rest. This ranking covers registered customers, excludes cancelled orders, and subtracts refunds.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id), refunds AS (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS r GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n JOIN analytics.fact_orders AS o ON o.order_id = n.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS g ON g.region_id = s.region_id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id WHERE g.city = 'Jakarta'
assumptions: “Jakarta” means the city Jakarta, not the wider DKI Jakarta province.
cases.answer: Net revenue sales in Jakarta were IDR 44.6B.

cases.sql: WITH order_net AS (SELECT o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) AS order_date, r.city, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_idr - oi.discount_idr) AS line_net FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.fact_order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE), r.city), refunds AS (SELECT fr.order_id, SUM(fr.refund_amount_idr) AS refunded FROM analytics.fact_returns AS fr GROUP BY fr.order_id) SELECT n.city AS city, SUM(n.line_net - COALESCE(r.refunded, 0)) AS net_revenue_idr FROM order_net AS n LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_id = n.order_id GROUP BY n.city ORDER BY n.city
cases.answer: Net revenue in September 2026 was IDR 512M in Bekasi, IDR 468M in Bogor, IDR 318M in Depok, IDR 1.45B in Jakarta, and IDR 612M in Tangerang.

cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN analytics.dim_region AS r ON r.region_id = s.region_id WHERE r.city = 'Surabaya' AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)
assumptions: Menghitung semua pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan, karena status tidak dibatasi.
cases.answer: Jumlah pesanan toko-toko di Surabaya bulan lalu adalah 0. Perhitungan mencakup semua pesanan, termasuk yang dibatalkan.

cases.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS store_name, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM analytics.fact_orders AS o JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 3
assumptions: “Orders” includes all order statuses, including cancelled orders, because no status filter was specified.
Results reflect only the regions available to the user under row-level security.
cases.answer: The top stores by orders in 2025 are Arunika Jakarta Senayan (866), Arunika Bogor Cibinong (648), and Arunika Tangerang BSD (645). Orders include all statuses, including cancelled orders, and results cover only regions available to the user under row-level security.
